title: Seagrove "Pura Vida" 167 San Roy Rd
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front w/ Private beach- Sprawling Gulf-front porches- Private Pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $45 per day*- 7 adult bikes- Complimentary beach setup each morning includes 2 seasonal beach sets, 4 chairs and 2 umbrellas (March 1 - October 31)- Low-Speed Vehicle- Putting green- Bocce ball- Outdoor kitchen- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Pura Vida is an exquisite Gulf-front home with a Carriage House that enjoys a private pool and awe-inspiring views of the Emerald Coast! This sensational 7-bedroom, 8-bathroom Seagrove Beach home sleeps 22. Nestled between the Gulf and Eastern Lake, guests will love the dedicated beach access off the back deck and complimentary beach service each morning.The second floor of this luxurious 3-story retreat invites guests into the heart of the home with beautiful hardwood floors, soaring ceilings, and breathtaking views. Designed with comfort in mind, the bright living area provides plush furnishings facing an impressive 75" TV, while the adjoining sitting area provides 4 additional armchairs. With high-end appliances and a spacious walk-in pantry, the gourmet kitchen is exceptional and is accented with blue and gold hues. The traditional dining area can host up to 10 guests for a sit-down dinner, while the breakfast bar seats 5 for a casual meal. Sliding glass doors in the great room open onto a fabulous second-story balcony with an alfresco dining table and plenty of seating—perfect for entertaining friends and family. Down the hallway is 1 primary bedroom fit for royalty, complete with a king-sized bed and a private bathroom.Ride the in-home elevator to the third floor of this home, where convenience meets comfort. With 2 primary bedrooms and a guest bedroom, each with a king-sized bed and private bathroom, it's easy to unwind and relax. Remember to take advantage of the laundry room and wet bar.Downstairs, guests can retire to the 2 lovely bedrooms on the first floor—1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and 1 bunk room with 3 sets of twin-over-twin bunkbeds. For added convenience, there's an additional living area with a queen sleeper sofa and a 75" TV. Enjoy the soothing sounds of the Gulf from the lower-level deck, complete with a private pool, outdoor shower, natural gas grill, loungers, and plenty of seating. It's an outdoor oasis!For extra privacy, the Carriage House offers 1 guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and a private bathroom.Get ready to indulge in beachfront bliss at Pura Vida! With on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle—it's easy to explore everything scenic 30A offers. Walk out the door to access the sugary-white beach! Book this gorgeous Alaya Collection home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 22)FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Three Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bath with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bath with Shower Only- Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa- Guest Bathroom: Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower Only- Guest Bathroom: Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower and Tub- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower and TubCarriage House:- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bath with Shower Only

With on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle—it's easy to explore everything scenic 30A offers. Walk out the door to access the sugary-white beach! Book this gorgeous Alaya Collection home today!
